name: vw_inventario_stock
definition:
SELECT i.id AS inventario_id,
    i.sucursal_id,
    s.nombre AS sucursal,
    i.variante_producto_id,
    vp.sku,
    p.id AS producto_id,
    p.nombre AS producto,
    t.id AS talla_id,
    t.nombre AS talla,
    c.id AS color_id,
    c.nombre AS color,
    i.temporada_id,
    te.nombre AS temporada,
    i.stock_actual,
    i.stock_reservado,
    i.stock_actual - i.stock_reservado AS stock_disponible,
    i.fecha_actualizacion
   FROM inventario i
     JOIN sucursal s ON s.id = i.sucursal_id
     JOIN variante_producto vp ON vp.id = i.variante_producto_id
     JOIN producto p ON p.id = vp.producto_id
     JOIN talla t ON t.id = vp.talla_id
     JOIN color c ON c.id = vp.color_id
     JOIN temporada te ON te.id = i.temporada_id;
